title: 第1章 开启英雄无敌系统第2章 初战兽人
content_zh:
第1章 开启英雄无敌系统
头有点晕，林天试着睁开眼，一抹冷光直奔而来，入目的是一个强壮而峥狞的类人怪物，两米以上的身高，两颗獠牙外露，非常类似以前玩过的魔兽世界里，兽人的造型，恩……我去，可不是就是兽人吗？难道自己穿到魔兽世界了？这让他这个二十一世纪的废物宅男情何以堪啊？
危险并未随着我们悲剧的主角陷入腹黑模式而消除，兽人暴喝着加速，利斧即将加身之时，这具身体自动抬起双手，脑海里放电影似的流过一串晦涩拗口的咒语，能听懂，是小火球，一颗篮球大小的火球迅速在手中成型，片刻之后高速脱离林天的掌握，强大的魔法能量撞开巨斧，在兽人战士惊恐的眼神中，击中它的胸口，爆炸击飞并剧烈燃烧……完美的秒杀，如果没有看我们主角，因为魔力耗尽反噬而吐血的话……
庞大的信息流窜入了林天的脑海：这里是剑魔大陆，剑与魔法的世界，庞大数量的种族共存百花齐放，人类不是最强的，相反，在这片未知的大陆中，兽人反而以其天生强健的体魄和战斗欲望，占据相当的优势。眼下的这片战场在人族东北方向，神圣狮鹫王国治下仙林郡。哈肯，也就是这具身体的原主人，是仙林郡领主之独子。
魂穿嘛，很正常的一种穿越方式，至于怎么穿过来的？这不重要，也没必要去纠结，至少比随便就去摸电线强。
“我会替你们报仇的！”林天瞥了一眼横七竖八，躺在地上的几十具人、兽尸体，其中有两具是哈肯的父母，仙林郡的领主和夫人，此时已经被兽人砍得不成人形了。
“如果没有英雄无敌系统，恐怕马上我也要脑袋搬家了吧？”某宅自嘲的笑了笑，心神沉入系统……不用担心有任何危险，因为心神进入系统时，外界时间是绝对静止的。
提示：英雄无敌系统开启，由于进入异界时与其他能量产生冲突，系统进行了规则融合和小规模的调整，基础模板沿用的是英雄无敌3和英雄无敌5，其他信息请英雄自行摸索！
提示：杀死兽人获得经验10！英雄林天，请选择主职业：人族骑士或人族牧师？
骑士！至少血多防高一点，对吧？至少不那么容易死，对吧？穿越到剑魔大陆，要泡mm，还是白马骑士更吃香一点，有木有？
提示：英雄骑士林天等级提升为1！恭喜你，抽取到传奇英雄模板，初始属性值为8，最大可学习能力为12项！
提示：抽取到天赋为优势大师！
提示：抽取到初始能力为初级进攻术，初级幸运术，初级智慧术！
提示：开启人族主城，新手大礼包！一连串的提示把林天给雷晕了，不过反映再迟钝，大概也知道自己是中大奖了，好歹以前还玩过很长一段时间的英雄无敌系列，算老手菜鸟了吧，为它搞过N个通宵，不陌生不陌生。
“能否为我介绍一下传奇英雄模板与其他英雄模板有什么区别？”
提示：系统无权回答任何问题，一切请英雄自行摸索！
不死心再试了好几个问题，比如我能不能复活啊？有没有药水啊？等等，全都是同样的提示。
“切……靠我自己猜是吧！一般英雄初始属性点应该为4，最多可学习8项能力，就是说传奇英雄起点更高了……不错，我喜欢！”
麻利的进入英雄资料界面，界面很熟悉。主职业人族骑士，属性为攻击3，防御2，法力1，知识2，额外增加生命值Hp50点，额外增加魔法值Mp30点；
副职业为1阶火系魔法学徒，现有的魔法只有0级冥想和1级小火球，Hp为50点，Mp为50点。

再看自己总的Hp为100点，Mp为80点。大概算了一下，应该生命值Hp=主职业攻击3+防御2乘以10，再加上副职业固定的50点=100点；魔法值Mp=主职业法力1+知识2乘以10，再加上副职业固定的50点=80点。
这么看来主职业的四围和副职业的等级，对生命和魔法上限影响很大，都很重要。
查看英雄天赋和能力。
优势大师：等级每提升一级，自己和部下能力全面提高1%，敌军能力全面降低1%.
初级进攻术：使自己和部下所有攻击效果提高10%。
初级幸运术：使自己和部下士气额外提高1，且幸运最少不低于0.
初级智慧术：使英雄可以学习1阶魔法。
目前一个装备都没有，英雄空间分为两部分，其中生物空间里现在什么都没有，而物品空间只有一个新手大礼包。很轻易的就
提示：获得10000金币，获得新手套装，已经自动装备；10份小瓶红药，10份小瓶蓝药。
连忙查看新手套装：+1攻击的新手剑，+1防御的新手铠，+1法力的新手手套，+1知识的新手头盔，+10%行动速度的新手鞋，+10%火焰抗性的火焰披风，+10%行动速度的新手坐骑战马。其他的还有1个项链位，2个戒指位，3个饰品位为空。
查看了一下英雄状态，果然，新手套装共增加了1攻击，1防御，1法力，1知识，总共增加了20点Hp和20点Mp，这说明之前的推断是正确的，不赖嘛！
进入人族城堡空间，目前完全无法招募士兵，可建造的建筑有1级内政厅需1000金，1阶铁匠铺－1000金，1阶市场－1000金，1阶魔法塔－2000金，0阶农民窝棚－500金，1阶长枪兵营－1000金；
“谁TM说要造内政厅来着？作死吗？”虽然搞游戏时一般来讲，先造1级内政厅攒钱是没错。不过请您老瞧瞧，外面老大一群兽人正在觅食呢，当然得先招兵！
“什么？招农民？拖出去弹jj！”某宅内心完全黑化狂暴了。
“建造1阶长枪兵营！消耗金币1000，剩余9000金！”
“招募所有长枪兵！”
“招募1阶长枪兵60单位，每单位10金，共计600金，剩余8400金！”
毫不留恋地退出系统，把60个长枪兵一口气召唤出来。
作战吧孩子们！
content_en:
Chapter 1 Turn on the hero invincibility system
Feeling a little dizzy, Lin Tian tried to open his eyes, and a cold light came straight towards him. What he saw was a strong and ferocious humanoid monster, more than two meters tall, with two fangs exposed. It was very similar to the shape of an orc in the World of Warcraft that he had played before. Well... Let me go, isn't it an orc? Could it be that he has traveled to World of Warcraft? How could this make him, a good-for-nothing otaku of the 21st century, embarrassed?
The danger did not disappear as our tragic protagonist fell into sinister mode. The orcs shouted and accelerated, and when the ax was about to attack, the body automatically raised its hands, and a series of obscure and difficult-to-speak spells flowed through the mind like a movie. If you can understand, it is a small fireball. A fireball the size of a basketball quickly appeared in the air. It took shape in the hand, and after a moment it escaped Lin Tian's grasp at high speed. The powerful magic energy knocked away the giant axe, and in the horrified eyes of the orc warriors, it hit its chest, exploded and burned violently... A perfect instant kill, if we hadn't seen our protagonist vomiting blood due to the exhaustion of magic power and backlash...
A huge flow of information rushed into Lin Tian's mind: This is the Sword Demon Continent, a world of swords and magic. A huge number of races coexist and a hundred flowers bloom. Humans are not the strongest. On the contrary, in this unknown continent, the orcs have a considerable advantage with their naturally strong physique and desire to fight. The current battlefield is in the northeast of the human race, in Xianlin County under the rule of the Holy Griffin Kingdom. Haken, the original owner of this body, is the only son of the lord of Xianlin County.
Soul travel is a very normal way of time travel, but how do you get there? It's not important, and there's no need to worry about it. At least it's better than just touching the wires casually.
"I will avenge you!" Lin Tian glanced at the dozens of human and animal corpses lying on the ground. Two of them were Haken's parents, the lord and wife of Xianlin County, who had been chopped by the orcs into human shapes.
"If there is no Heroes Invincible System, I'm afraid I will have to move my head soon, right?" A certain house laughed to himself, and his mind sank into the system... There is no need to worry about any danger, because when the mind enters the system, the external time is absolutely still.
Tip: The Heroes Invincible system is enabled. Due to conflicts with other energies when entering another world, the system has undergone rule integration and small-scale adjustments. The basic templates follow Heroes Invincible 3 and Heroes Invincible 5. For other information, please explore by yourself!
Tip: Kill an orc to gain experience 10! Hero Lin Tian, ​​please choose your main profession: Human Knight or Human Priest?
knight! At least the more blood you have, the higher your defense will be, right? At least it's not that easy to die, right? Traveling to the Sword Demon Continent, which girl is more popular, or the knight on the white horse, is it more popular?
Tip: Hero Knight Lin Tian’s level has been increased to 1! Congratulations, you have extracted the legendary hero template. The initial attribute value is 8 and the maximum learnable ability is 12!
Tip: The talent extracted is the advantage master!
Tips: The initial abilities extracted are primary offense, primary luck, and primary wisdom!
Tip: Open the main city of the human race and get a big gift package for newbies! A series of prompts stunned Lin Tian, ​​but no matter how slow his reaction was, he probably knew that he had won the jackpot. After all, he had played the Heroes of Invincible series for a long time before, so he was considered a veteran and a novice. He had worked on it for N times all night, so he was familiar with it.
"Can you tell me the difference between the legendary hero template and other hero templates?"
Tip: The system does not have the authority to answer any questions, so the hero is left to explore on his own!
Unwilling to give up, I tried several more questions, such as can I be resurrected? Is there any potion? Wait, it’s all the same prompt.
"Tch... I have to guess on my own! The initial attribute points of a general hero should be 4, and they can learn up to 8 abilities. This means that legendary heroes have a higher starting point... Not bad, I like it!"
Easily enter the world of hero informationThe interface is very familiar. The main profession is a human knight, with attributes of attack 3, defense 2, mana 1, knowledge 2, with an additional HP of 50 points and an additional MP of 30 points;
The secondary profession is a level 1 fire magic apprentice. The existing magics are only level 0 meditation and level 1 small fireball. The HP is 50 points and the MP is 50 points.
Look at your total HP as 100 points and MP as 80 points. After a rough calculation, it should be that health value Hp = main occupation attack 3 + defense 2 times 10, plus the fixed 50 points of the sub-professional = 100 points; magic value Mp = main occupation mana 1 + knowledge 2 multiplied by 10, plus the fixed 50 points of the sub-professional = 80 points.
From this point of view, the surroundings of the main profession and the level of the sub-profession have a great impact on the upper limit of life and magic, and they are both very important.
View hero talents and abilities.
Advantage Master: Every time the level increases, the abilities of yourself and your subordinates will increase by 1%, and the enemy's abilities will decrease by 1%.
Primary offensive technique: Increases the effectiveness of all attacks by yourself and your subordinates by 10%.
Elementary Luck Technique: Increase the morale of yourself and your subordinates by an additional 1, and the luck should be at least no less than 0.
Primary Wisdom: Allows the hero to learn level 1 magic.
There is currently no equipment, and the hero space is divided into two parts. There is currently nothing in the creature space, and there is only a newbie gift pack in the item space. Very easily
Tips: Obtain 10,000 gold coins and get the novice set, which is automatically equipped; 10 small bottles of red medicine and 10 small bottles of blue medicine.
Quickly check the novice set: novice sword with +1 attack, novice armor with +1 defense, novice gloves with +1 mana, novice helmet with +1 knowledge, novice shoes with +10% action speed, flame cloak with +10% fire resistance, and novice mount war horse with +10% action speed. Others include 1 necklace slot, 2 ring slots, and 3 jewelry slots.
After checking the hero status, sure enough, the novice suit added a total of 1 attack, 1 defense, 1 mana, and 1 knowledge, adding a total of 20 HP and 20 MP points. This shows that the previous inference is correct, not bad!
Entering the human castle space, it is currently impossible to recruit soldiers. The buildings that can be built include level 1 interior hall for 1000 gold, level 1 blacksmith shop - 1000 gold, level 1 market - 1000 gold, level 1 magic tower - 2000 gold, level 0 farmer shack - 500 gold, level 1 pike barracks - 1000 gold;
"Who the hell said you want to build the Interior Hall? Are you seeking death?" Generally speaking, when playing games, it is right to build a level 1 Interior Hall first to save money. But please take a look, a group of orcs are looking for food outside. Of course, we need to recruit troops first!
"What? Recruiting farmers? Drag them out to have sex!" A certain house went completely black and furious.
"Build a level 1 pike barracks! It cost 1,000 gold coins and left 9,000 gold!"
"Recruit all pikemen!"
"Recruit 60 units of level 1 spearmen, each unit has 10 gold, a total of 600 gold, and the remaining 8400 gold!"
Exit the system without any regrets and summon 60 spearmen in one go.
Fight, kids!
